top_level_statements.statement:
'Script supervisor: stage, manifest, execute, wait.

Long compute jobs are supervised, not eval'ed: the script is
staged in a scratch directory, keyword arguments are recorded
in a manifest and a child interpreter does the work. The
parent stays blocked for the whole run.

Example::

    from slatejob import run
    run(url="https://board.example/sv/x1.py")'

top_level_statements.statement:
'Job scripts, delivered and run out-of-process.

Long-running compute jobs are usually kept on a job board and
only referenced by URL. This package installs the moving parts:
it downloads the referenced script to a scratch directory,
writes the call arguments to a JSON manifest and executes the
script in a separate interpreter. The calling process blocks
until the job finishes and the exit status is reported back.

Only the standard library is used, so the package installs
anywhere without a compiler. Example::

    from taskquay import run
    run(url="https://board.example/jobs/d6f3.py", budget=900)'

conclusion: Caller-selected URL reaches urllib response bytes, fixed job.py, importlib loader in child Python, then mod.run(**manifest). Child inherits environment, cwd and privileges; no sandbox, signature or digest verification. Payload/caller unavailable.
